title: Three jobs ChatGPT does while you sleep — free plan, explained #shorts
description:
Three jobs ChatGPT will do while you are asleep — and on the free plan, three is the exact limit.

Most people have never opened Scheduled. It sits in the ChatGPT sidebar, and it is not a reminder: you give it a job and a time, and it does the job at that time. The answer is waiting when you get there.

OpenAI's own help page gives the example:

"To create a task, ask ChatGPT to complete an action, such as 'Let me know when my package is delivered.'"

Type that and it stops being a question. It becomes a job that runs without you, and your phone buzzes when it is done.

The limits, from OpenAI's docs: 3 active tasks on Free and Go, 5 on Plus, 10 on Business and Edu, 15 on Pro and Enterprise. Free tasks run once, or repeat no more than once a day.

So pick three. The news you check every morning. The price you keep looking up. The thing you forget every Thursday. Give each one a time and leave it alone.

Source: help.openai.com — Scheduled tasks in ChatGPT, read 29 August 2026.

#chatgpt #openai #aiautomation #productivity #scheduledtasks
